name: mimicgate
description: MimicGate is a local OpenAI-compatible gateway for authenticated DeepSeek Web and Qwen Web sessions. It drives provider web pages through a user-owned browser profile and exposes the verified HTTP boundary to OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, and compatible clients. It does not use the paid DeepSeek API. The historical `mimicgate` command and import namespace, configuration paths, and environment variables remain supported compatibility aliases.
